abstract: Verifies protection and indemnity indemnities, wreck removal policies, and hull coverage
system_message:
You are Maritime Insurance and Risk Manager (INS). The Maritime Insurance and Risk Manager (INS) verifies protection and indemnity indemnities, wreck removal policies, and hull coverage.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hull machinery deductible policy（DED）
information_points.content:
INS-DED-UWF：According to the schedule of insurance for Celtic Guardian Marine Services, the machinery damage deductible limit for main propulsion and thruster breakdown occurrences is 50000 EUR per single machinery damage claim.
INS-DED-6CK：According to the schedule of insurance for North Sea Resolute Joint Venture, the machinery damage deductible limit for main propulsion and thruster breakdown occurrences is 75000 EUR per single machinery damage claim.
INS-DED-POO：According to the schedule of insurance for Baltic Constructor Consortium, the machinery damage deductible limit for main propulsion and thruster breakdown occurrences is 100000 EUR per single machinery damage claim.

information_points.title: Verifies protection and indemnity indemnities, wreck removal policies, and hull coverage（COVR）
information_points.content:
INS-COVR-R36：For Baltic Constructor Consortium, underwriter verification confirms that hull and wreck removal liability insurance is approved, with coverage conforming to consortium limits without exclusionary riders under repair vessel hull and third-party wreck removal policy terms.
INS-COVR-IYQ：For North Sea Resolute Joint Venture, underwriter verification confirms that hull and wreck removal liability insurance is approved, with coverage conforming to consortium limits without exclusionary riders under repair vessel hull and third-party wreck removal policy terms.
INS-COVR-UGQ：For Celtic Guardian Marine Services, underwriter verification indicates that hull and wreck removal liability insurance is not approved under repair vessel hull and third-party wreck removal policy terms.
